reached.basis: The library reached by its name and its domain, three days after its founding.

atoms.span: self-governing, provenance-first repository for machine-mediated scholarship
explicit governance principles (no automated obelus/judgment, substrate disclosure as provenance, no classifier training without opt-in)
it was founded in response to a documented mass removal of scholarly works/DOIs

observations.notes: Five of eleven. No person, no founding date, no Semantic Economy, no Crimson Hexagonal Archive; the AXN is named as a scheme, no record address given. The issue date (2026-06-22) is the card's, not the founding's, and is not counted as the date atom.
